template: On the ticket detail view for ticket '{{v1}}' (reference {{v3}}, currently status {{v4}}), remove both parts: delete '{{v5}}' and '{{v6}}' using their per-row delete controls, confirming any confirmation dialog that appears. If the app refuses to delete a part while the ticket is {{v4}}, discover what it requires (e.g. moving the ticket back to {{v7}} first) and satisfy that, then delete both parts. Then archive the ticket using the 'Archive ticket' action, satisfying any precondition the app enforces for archiving. Report exactly what was required to delete the parts and to archive, the parts list state at the end, and where the ticket ended up (e.g. an archived list or absent from the active list).

The parts table is now empty ("No parts on this ticket yet.", 0 parts) and the detail view shows an "Archived" badge with status still {{v4}} and actions Mark {{v7}} / Mark Closed / Unarchive ticket. {{v3}} is gone from the default tickets list and reappears only when "Show archived" is checked.
